in_arabic.name: حفيظ
in_arabic.long_meaning: حفيظ هو اسم علم مذكر عربي يعود إلى الجذر ح ف ظ، والذي يرمز إلى الحفظ والصيانة، وقد استخدم في التاريخ الإسلامي لوصف الشخص الذي يحفظ القرآن الكريم أو الحديث النبوي، وله معنی روحاني sâuك في الإسلام

in_urdu.name: حفیظ
in_urdu.long_meaning: حفیظ ایک عربی نام ہے جو ح ف ظ سے ماخوذ ہے، جو حفاظت اور صيانة کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے، اور اسے اسلامی تاریخ میں قرآن مجید یا حدیث نبوی کو حفظ کرنے والے شخص کے لیے استعمال کیا گیا ہے، اور اس کا اسلامی روایات میں گہرا معنی ہے

in_hindi.name: हुफ़ैज़

in_pashto.name: حفیظ

data.cultural_impact: The title Hufayz reflects the importance of preserving the sacred teachings of Islam. Memorizing the Quran is considered a significant achievement in Islamic culture and is often seen as a mark of respect, dedication, and religious commitment. Hufayz are revered figures in Islamic communities and play an important role in the preservation and transmission of the Islamic faith.
data.spiritual_significance: To be a Hufayz is not just a title, it is a spiritual journey that requires dedication, discipline, and a deep connection to Allah (God). Memorizing the Quran is a way for Muslims to internalize the divine words, and to cultivate a deeper understanding of God and His teachings. The Quran is considered the literal word of God, and to memorize it is to remember Allah's words and to carry them in one's heart. The Hufayz plays an essential role in the spiritual life of their community by acting as a beacon of knowledge and piety, inspiring others through their commitment and devotion to the Quran and to Allah.
